text: PyYAML advisory CVE-2020-14343 (GHSA-8q59-q68h-6hv4): parsing untrusted YAML with yaml.load() or the FullLoader can execute arbitrary Python code and construct arbitrary objects. Applications must use yaml.safe_load(). Resolved in PyYAML 5.4.

requests advisory CVE-2023-32681 (GHSA-j8r2-6x86-q33q): the Proxy-Authorization header is leaked to the destination server when a request is redirected to a different host. Affects requests versions below 2.31.0.

urllib3 advisory CVE-2023-45803 (GHSA-g4mx-q9vg-27p4): when a redirect changes the HTTP method to GET, the original request body is still transmitted, potentially leaking sensitive data. Fixed in urllib3 1.26.18 and 2.0.7.

Jinja2 advisory CVE-2024-34064 (GHSA-h75v-3vvj-5mfj): the xmlattr filter accepts keys containing spaces and other characters, allowing HTML attribute injection and cross-site scripting. Fixed in Jinja2 3.1.4.
certifi advisory CVE-2023-37920 (GHSA-xqr8-7jwr-rhjr): the certificate bundle trusted the compromised e-Tugra root certificate authority. The affected root was removed in certifi 2023.07.22.
setuptools advisory CVE-2022-40897 (GHSA-r9hx-vwmv-q579): a regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) in package_index lets a malicious HTML index page hang the parser. Fixed in setuptools 65.5.1.
Pillow advisory CVE-2022-45198: a crafted image file can trigger excessive resource use (denial of service) when the application opens it with Image.open(). Users should upgrade to Pillow 9.3.0.

requests-oauthlib documentation: this library adds OAuth 1 and OAuth 2 authentication support to the requests HTTP client, providing request signing and token fetching helpers. It is a separate project from requests and has no security advisory here.
requests 2.31.0 changelog: security release. The Proxy-Authorization header is now stripped when a request is redirected to a different host, preventing credential leakage to unintended servers.
urllib3 1.26.18 changelog: security fix. The request body is now stripped when a redirect changes the request method to GET, so payloads are no longer resent to the redirect target.
Jinja2 3.1.4 changelog: the xmlattr filter now rejects keys containing spaces, slashes, and other unsafe characters, closing an attribute-injection vector.
PyYAML 5.4 changelog: yaml.load() now defaults to FullLoader, which does not construct arbitrary Python objects, making the default load path safe against untrusted input.
certifi 2023.07.22 changelog: removed the e-Tugra root certificate from the trusted bundle following its compromise.

Click documentation: Click is a Python library for building composable command-line interfaces with decorators, argument parsing, and nested commands. General usage reference with no security advisory.
